partners.mechanism_chain: ANKH (HGNC:771) —DECREASES→ extracellular pyrophosphate (CHEBI:17796); extracellular pyrophosphate (CHEBI:17796) —DISRUPTS→ chondrocyte differentiation and mineralization (GO:0001503); chondrocyte differentiation and mineralization (GO:0001503) —LEADS_TO→ Craniometaphyseal dysplasia (HP:0004442); chondrocyte differentiation and mineralization (GO:0001503) —LEADS_TO→ Chondrocalcinosis (HP:0002706). Both diseases involve disruptions in fundamental cellular processes related to ion transport and post-translational modification, suggesting an overlap in cellular vulnerability.

**How to falsify it:** Demonstration that ANKH and MAGT1 function in entirely independent cellular pathways with no downstream convergence on shared molecular mechanisms or cellular phenotypes. _(variant: Presence of high-frequency pathogenic variants in gnomAD for either ANKH or MAGT1 that are not associated with either phenotype.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared pathways affected by mutations in ANKH and MAGT1 could reveal novel therapeutic targets for rare diseases impacting bone mineralization and immune function. For instance, interventions aimed at restoring magnesium homeostasis or improving protein glycosylation might offer a therapeutic avenue for aspects of craniometaphyseal dysplasia or ameliorate immune defects in MAGT1-related disorders.
